title: Poker Arena: Multi-Axis Profiling of Strategic Reasoning and Memory in LLMs
title_zh: Poker Arena：LLM 战略推理与记忆能力的多维剖析
abstract_en: Strategic reasoning under uncertainty underpins consequential decisions in negotiation, finance, and policy, but prevailing game-play benchmarks collapse heterogeneous reasoning dimensions into a single scalar, leaving the capability structure of frontier LLMs unexamined. We introduce Poker Arena, a no-limit Texas Hold'em tournament platform that couples a three-layer memory architecture (within-hand, session, and cross-session) with a nine-axis cognitive profile decomposing strategic reasoning into interpretable dimensions such as bet-sizing calibration and positional awareness. We evaluate seven frontier models across 50 sessions of 1,000 hands and a controlled memory ablation; tournament chips and aggregate axis score order the field differently: Claude Opus 4.6 wins +$15,730 chips with 14 first-place finishes, yet ranks only fifth of seven on mean axis score, while persistent memory helps some models and hurts others. These findings show that multi-axis evaluation surfaces capability structure that scalar leaderboards systematically misrank, with cross-dimensional consistency outweighing peak performance on any single axis.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 Poker Arena，一个用于评估 LLM 在不确定性下战略推理能力的无限注 Texas Hold’em 锦标赛平台。不同于将游戏表现压缩为单一分数的传统 benchmark，Poker Arena 结合三层记忆架构（单手牌内、单场 session、跨 session）与九轴认知画像，将战略推理拆解为 bet-sizing calibration、positional awareness 等可解释维度。作者评估了 7 个前沿模型，在 50 个 session、每个 1,000 手牌的设置下进行比赛，并加入受控记忆消融实验。结果显示，锦标赛筹码收益与九轴平均分会给出显著不同的模型排序：Claude Opus 4.6 以 +$15,730 筹码和 14 次第一名赢得比赛，但其平均轴分仅排第 5；持久记忆对部分模型有帮助，却会损害另一些模型表现。研究表明，多轴评估能揭示单一排行榜掩盖的能力结构，且跨维度一致性比单一维度峰值表现更关键。
key_points_zh: 提出 Poker Arena，将 no-limit Texas Hold’em 作为不确定性战略推理评测场景，面向 negotiation、finance、policy 等高风险决策能力。
设计三层 memory architecture：within-hand memory、session memory、cross-session memory，用于分析短期与长期记忆对策略表现的影响。
构建九轴 cognitive profile，将模型能力拆解为 bet-sizing calibration、positional awareness 等可解释战略维度，而非单一胜率或筹码分数。
在 7 个 frontier LLM、50 个 session、每场 1,000 hands 上评测，发现筹码排行榜与多轴能力排序不一致：Claude Opus 4.6 赢得最多筹码，但平均轴分仅第 5。
记忆并非普遍增益：persistent memory 对部分模型提升表现，对另一些模型反而有害，说明模型的跨维度稳定性比单点强项更重要。

llm_assessment.comment: Poker Arena is mainly a capability-profiling benchmark and has limited relevance to agent harness evolution beyond evaluation methodology.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: Poker Arena 主要是能力画像基准，除评测方法外与智能体框架演进关联有限。
